name: Simple Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, a Simple Sigil calls novice night elf warriors to training with Alyissia. It marks their first step into Teldrassil’s defense.

sections.title: A Summons to Arms
sections.body: In Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine guides young night elves as they seek their calling. A runner brings a Simple Sigil from the warrior trainer Alyissia, and Ilthalaine gives it to fledgling warriors. Its inscription tells each recruit to report for instruction. The token marks the start of their martial training as troubling times come to the World Tree.

sections.title: The Burden of Defense
sections.body: Alyissia uses the sigil to speak with recruits about the kaldorei’s pressing needs. Teldrassil’s recent growth, corruption spreading among forest beasts, and the rediscovery of distant lands such as Feralas have stretched night elven protectors thin. The sigil holds no power. It welcomes a recruit among the guardians charged with shielding their people from emerging threats.

faq.answer: The Simple Sigil is an inscribed token for novice night elf warriors in Shadowglen. Conservator Ilthalaine gives it to them, and its inscription directs them to report to Alyissia for training.
A runner carries the Simple Sigil from Alyissia, the warrior trainer in Shadowglen, to Conservator Ilthalaine, who gives it to novice warriors.

faq.q: What should I do with it?
aliases: where to turn in simple sigil
faq.answer: Read the inscription and take the Simple Sigil to Alyissia near the base of Aldrassil in Shadowglen to begin your warrior training.

faq.q: Does the sigil grant any special abilities?
faq.answer: No. The Simple Sigil is a written notice that introduces aspiring warriors to their mentor.

angles.text: As a kaldorei warrior, the Simple Sigil is your first credential in the martial traditions used to safeguard Teldrassil.
As a night elf, you see the urgency facing the kaldorei: Alyissia and other trainers recruit capable hands to fight the growing corruption in the boughs of the World Tree.
